name: Denumerable

source.code:
/-- A denumerable type is (constructively) bijective with `ℕ`. Typeclass equivalent of `α ≃ ℕ`. -/
class Denumerable (α : Type*) extends Encodable α where
  /-- `decode` and `encode` are inverses. -/
  decode_inv : ∀ n, ∃ a ∈ decode n, encode a = n
